select fpd.finprod_id finprodId, fpd.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, fpd.finprod_name finprodName, fpd.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, fpd.profit_type profitType, fpd.issue_price issuePrice, fpd.issue_amt issueAmt, fpd.issue_Type issueType, fpd.CCY ccy, fpd.OPERATION_TYPE operationType, fpd.TRUSTEE_ID trusteeId, '' investType, '' raiseType, DATE_FORMAT(fpd.VDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') vdate, DATE_FORMAT(fpd.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') mdate,
DATE_FORMAT(fpd.actmdate, '%Y-%m-%d') actmdate, DATE_FORMAT(fpd.LIQUIDATION_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') liquidationDate, (fpd.MDATE-fpd.VDATE+1) term, 'A/365' basis, ext.sale_period salePeriod, case when IFNULL(ext.sale_layer,0)!=0 then 'Y' else 'N' end isSaleLayer, ext.IS_RECONCILIATION isReconciliation, ext.CREATE_ORG createOrg, ext.VAL_ORG valOrg, mci1.CUSTOMER_NAME createOrgName, mci2.CUSTOMER_NAME valOrgName, ext.IS_CYCLE isCycle, ext.PROD_REGIST_CODE prodRegistCode, ext.PROFIT_FLAG profitFlag, fpd.p_Finprod_Id pFinprodId, fpd.is_chl isChl, fpd.is_sus isSus, fpd.is_right isRight, SUM(amt.trade_amt) planraiseAmt, (case when bbext.PARAM_VALUE = 'Y' then 'true' else 'false' end) isTrustCurrent, fpd.CALENDAR_ID AS calendarId, C.CALENDAR_NAME AS calendarName, pvp.UNITVALUE_DEC AS unitvalueDec, pvp.UNITVALUE_MODE AS unitvalueMode, pvp.MILION_PROFIT_DEC AS milionProfitDec, pvp.MILION_PROFIT_DEC_MODE AS milionProfitDecMode, pvp.YEAR_YIELD_DEC AS yearYieldDec, pvp.YEAR_YIELD_DEC_MODE AS yearYieldDecMode, pvp.IS_COUNTING_CUR_INT AS isCountingCurInt from FIN_PRODUCT fpd left join FIN_PRODUCT_add ext on fpd.finprod_id = ext.finprod_id left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci1 on ext.CREATE_ORG = mci1.CUSTOMER_ID left join MST_CUSTOMER_INFO mci2 on ext.VAL_ORG = mci2.CUSTOMER_ID left join ( select sum(tpd.trade_amt) trade_amt,tpd.finprod_id,tpd.settle_date from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd where 1=1 AND (tpd.finprod_type = #{finprodTypeF16} or tpd.finprod_type = #{finprodTypeF55}) group by tpd.finprod_id,tpd.settle_date )amt on fpd.finprod_id = amt.finprod_id and amt.settle_date = fpd.VDATE LEFT JOIN MST_CALENDAR_INFO C ON C.CALENDAR_ID = fpd.CALENDAR_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_EXT bbext ON bbext.BOOKSET_ID = fpd.finprod_id AND bbext.PARAM_CODE = 'PRD_IS_CALC' LEFT JOIN PRD_VAL_PARAM pvp ON pvp.FINPROD_ID = fpd.finprod_id where (fpd.finprod_type = #{finprodTypeF16} or fpd.finprod_type = #{finprodTypeF55}) AND (fpd.profit_type = #{profitType01} or fpd.profit_type = #{profitType03})
AND fpd.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND fpd.profit_Type in
#{profitType}
AND fpd.OPERATION_TYPE in
#{operationType}
AND fpd.FINPROD_id in
#{finprodId}
AND fpd.VDATE >=STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStart},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND fpd.VDATE <=STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND fpd.mDATE >=STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateStart},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND fpd.mDATE <=STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
group by fpd.finprod_id , fpd.finprod_abbr , fpd.finprod_name , fpd.FINPROD_TYPE , fpd.profit_type , fpd.issue_price , fpd.issue_amt , fpd.issue_Type , fpd.CCY , fpd.OPERATION_TYPE, fpd.TRUSTEE_ID, fpd.VDATE , fpd.MDATE , fpd.LIQUIDATION_DATE, fpd.actmdate, ext.sale_period , ext.sale_layer, ext.profit_flag, ext.IS_RECONCILIATION, ext.CREATE_ORG, ext.VAL_ORG, mci1.CUSTOMER_NAME, mci2.CUSTOMER_NAME, ext.IS_CYCLE, ext.PROD_REGIST_CODE, ext.PROFIT_FLAG, fpd.p_Finprod_Id , fpd.is_chl , fpd.is_sus , fpd.is_right , bbext.PARAM_VALUE, fpd.CALENDAR_ID , C.CALENDAR_NAME, pvp.UNITVALUE_DEC, pvp.UNITVALUE_MODE, pvp.MILION_PROFIT_DEC, pvp.MILION_PROFIT_DEC_MODE, pvp.YEAR_YIELD_DEC, pvp.YEAR_YIELD_DEC_MODE, pvp.IS_COUNTING_CUR_INT order by fpd.VDATE desc,fpd.profit_type

select fpd.finprod_id finprodId, fpd.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, fpd.finprod_name finprodName, fpd.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, fpd.profit_type profitType, fpd.p_Finprod_Id pFinprodId, pfpd.finprod_name pFinprodName, basi.acct_subject_name acctSubjectName, fpd.issue_price issuePrice, fpd.issue_amt issueAmt, fpd.issue_Type issueType, fpd.CCY ccyCode, fpd.CCY ccy, fpd.REGIST_ORG registOrg, crule.yield * 100 yield, '' investType, '' raiseType, DATE_FORMAT(fpd.VDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') vdate, DATE_FORMAT(fpd.MDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') mdate, DATE_FORMAT(fpd.iDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') idate, DATE_FORMAT(fpd.actmdate, '%Y-%m-%d') actmdate, fpd.MDATE - fpd.vDATE term, 'A/365' basis, ext.sale_period salePeriod, case when IFNULL(ext.sale_layer, 0) != 0 then 'Y' else 'N' end isSaleLayer, ext.profit_flag prdIncomeType, ext.profit_flag prdIncomeTypeCode,
(case when ext.IS_RECONCILIATION = 'Y' then 'true' else 'false' end) isReconciliation, fpd.o_Finprod_Id oFinprodId, fpd.is_chl isChl, fpd.is_sus isSus, fpd.is_right isRight, amt.trade_amt planraiseAmt,
(case when bbext.PARAM_VALUE = 'Y' then 'true' else 'false' end)isTrustCurrent, fpd.CALENDAR_ID AS calendarId, C.CALENDAR_NAME AS calendarName from FIN_PRODUCT fpd left join (select a.* from fin_cash_calc_rule a left join FIN_CASH_INFO b on a.cash_id = b.cash_id where b.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C02') crule on crule.EFF_DATE = fpd.VDATE and crule.FINPROD_ID = fpd.FINPROD_ID and crule.FINPROD_TYPE = fpd.FINPROD_TYPE left join FIN_PRODUCT pfpd on pfpd.finprod_id = fpd.p_finprod_id left join FIN_PRODUCT_ADD ext on fpd.finprod_id = ext.finprod_id
left join BOK_ACCT_SUBJECT_INFO basi on basi.acct_subject_id = ext.portfolio_id left join (select sum(tpd.trade_amt) trade_amt, tpd.finprod_id, tpd.settle_date, tpd.finprod_type from TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd group by tpd.finprod_id, tpd.settle_date, tpd.finprod_type) amt on fpd.finprod_id = amt.finprod_id and amt.settle_date = fpd.VDATE and amt.finprod_type = fpd.finprod_type LEFT JOIN MST_CALENDAR_INFO C ON C.CALENDAR_ID = fpd.CALENDAR_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_BOOKSET_EXT bbext ON bbext.BOOKSET_ID = fpd.finprod_id AND bbext.PARAM_CODE = 'PRD_IS_CALC' where 1=1
AND fpd.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND fpd.profit_Type in
#{profitType}
AND fpd.OPERATION_TYPE in
#{operationType}
AND fpd.FINPROD_id in
#{finprodId}
AND fpd.VDATE >=STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateStart},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND fpd.VDATE <=STR_TO_DATE(#{vdateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND fpd.mDATE >=STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateStart},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND fpd.mDATE <=STR_TO_DATE(#{mdateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d')
order by fpd.VDATE desc,fpd.profit_type

select prd.finprod_id id, IFNULL(prd.finprod_abbr,prd.finprod_name) text from fin_product prd where 1=1
AND prd.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType}
AND (prd.finprod_id like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR prd.finprod_abbr like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%') OR prd.finprod_name like concat_ws('','%',#{search},'%'))
order by prd.finprod_id
SELECT PARAM_VALUE AS paramValue FROM BOK_BOOKSET_EXT WHERE PARAM_CODE=#{paramCode} and BOOKSET_ID = #{finprodId} and LIMIT=1
